name: hud_sensor_tracker_unload_objectives
description: HudSensorTracker::UnloadObjectives resets objective slots and counters when not networked, preserves objective state when networked, frees the loaded objective tree, and returns success. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x417ee0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same network gate, slot loop, counter reset, optional zReader::FreeLoadedTree call, and success return.
The dependency frontier for 0x417ee0 has no visible source blockers after accepting HudSensorObjectiveSlot::Reset; zOpt::GetNetworkEnabled and zReader::FreeLoadedTree are accepted dependencies.
The native hud_sensor_tracker_unload_objectives_smoke verifies disabled-network reset semantics and enabled-network preservation semantics.
